params._comment: C15 credits opener, FXTEAM CUT-CREDITS reshoot: 140t SLOW dolly onto the survivor posed at the ghost ship's wheel. World-anchored — CreditsSequence passes the helm player's feet as the play anchor, so every pos/lookAt here is an offset from that spot (the wheel prop sits ~1.1 blocks toward +X, ~1.5 up). The last two keyframes drift the lookAt toward the hands-on-wheel point and end the camera low and just off-axis so the wheel display frames the right of the lens in the near field. FOV runs a 66→63→60→58 intimacy squeeze (most of it spent across the final 58% of the flight). The t=0.72 'wheel' whisper lands on the hands-settle beat — CreditsSequence nudges the wheel display a few degrees at run ticks 148/160 to sell the grip. The shot still ends 20t before the whiteout rises, handing the camera back for one breath at the wheel.
params._doc: lookAt points share the keyframe coordinate space (anchor offsets here); showOwnBody keeps the helm player visible in their own shot.
